high_level_description: A clean, high-resolution 1600x900 landscape structural layout featuring five isolated, large-scale objects on a pale neutral background: a red tennis ball, a green garden hose with nozzle, a bicycle with wicker basket holding wilted daisies, an ivy-covered pickup truck emphasizing its front hood, and a symmetrical quadcopter drone.

style_description.lighting: Flat, even studio lighting with no shadows

compositional_deconstruction.background: Uniform pale neutral background (#f8f8f8), no texture or gradient

elements.desc: Red tennis ball — solid circle centered at (180,180), radius 60, fill #e53935
Green garden hose — horizontal rectangle 300×24 at y=120, fill #43a047; nozzle — 36×36 square attached right end, fill #2e7d32
Bicycle with wicker basket and wilted daisies — simplified side silhouette: two black wheels (r=48), gray frame, beige basket (rounded rect), and 4 small brown-yellow wilted daisy shapes inside
Ivy-covered pickup truck front hood — trapezoidal hood shape in ivy-green (#558b2f), with two white headlight circles and black grille; four small dark-green circles scattered to suggest ivy
Drone — central gray body circle, four thin gray arms extending orthogonally, and four white rotor circles at arm tips
